fields.description: The Bristol combines branded apartments, penthouses and a planned lifestyle hotel at Emaar Beachfront. One to four bedroom apartments sit alongside five bedroom penthouses, with broad balconies and full-height glazing oriented towards the coastal setting. Beach access, pools and landscaped podium spaces place outdoor leisure close to home.

overview: The development shares Emaar Beachfront’s coastal setting beside Dubai Harbour. Its brochure describes apartments and penthouses alongside a five-star lifestyle hotel, with open living areas and large windows. Residents’ leisure spaces include pools, play areas and a gym, while wellness and dining form part of the wider proposition. Confirm which services are included in ownership and which carry separate charges.
research.locationNote: The Bristol is at Emaar Beachfront in Dubai Harbour, between the Dubai Marina waterfront and Palm Jumeirah. The developer’s map identifies access towards Sheikh Zayed Road and the wider city. Beachfront orientation varies by residence; a particular sea or landmark view needs confirmation against the selected unit.
research.priceNote: The official page advertises a starting price of AED 3.66 million. This is a project headline rather than a live quotation; current availability, unit price and applicable terms must be confirmed.
research.paymentNote: The January 2025 launch schedule comprises 10% on booking, seven 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Historic dates and construction milestones are shown for reference, not as a fresh reservation offer.
research.handoverNote: The launch payment document targets September 2029 for estimated construction completion. Property Finder reports the same month. Obtain the contractual handover date and latest progress for the selected residence.

facts.label: Published launch mix
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 58 one bedroom, 100 two bedroom, 51 three bedroom and 14 four bedroom apartments, plus four five bedroom penthouses. This differs from the current page’s wording; it is not an available-stock count.

facts.label: Historical type prices
facts.value: Launch starting prices were AED 3.66 million, AED 6.36 million, AED 10.38 million and AED 14.45 million for one to four bedrooms respectively; five bedroom penthouses started at AED 34 million.

facts.label: Tower and penthouse planning
facts.value: The plan booklet labels the tower B+G+8P+44. Four penthouse layouts occupy levels 43 and 44; they include a study, home theatre, family room, wet/dry kitchens, maid’s room and several balconies.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: Each total combines internal suite and balcony areas. Check the specific level and unit plan, as balcony depths and totals differ within the same bedroom category.

facts.label: Interior material palette
facts.value: The material board shows marble flooring, timber-toned joinery, bronze-toned metal, ribbed glass cabinet fronts and shower feature tiles. It is a design reference; final materials and supplied fittings require contractual confirmation.
